verdict: Leads surged this week; cost per lead dropped sharply, tracking needs repair.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 18 leads at a cost of $158.95 per lead — and the most recent 7-day window drove that number sharply higher, with leads up 367% versus the prior 7 days. Meta campaigns are producing the volume; Google Ads also ran at $2,120.45 in spend this period, but conversion tracking between Google and your contact system is currently broken, meaning Google leads are likely under-reported rather than absent — that repair is in progress now. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile generated 26 calls and 121 total actions over the 28 days, though profile activity softened in the last week, which we are watching closely. Next period, expect cleaner lead counts across all channels once tracking is restored, and steadier daily spend as campaigns stabilize.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, with the majority arriving in the most recent week
cost per lead this period, down sharply from the prior 7-day rate
phone calls generated through your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: Google Ads conversion tracking is not recording leads in your contact pipeline, causing Google results to appear as zero when leads are likely coming through.
watch_item.fix: Tracking is being repaired this week so that every channel reports accurately on the same dashboard next period.
